Evox Orders & ASM Channel Routing Hub

2-Tier Channel Architecture

Evox Central Depot → Primary Distributor (PD) → Secondary Distributor (SD). ASMs hold order-wise authority to route SD orders to any candidate PD.

Order Procurement Territory / State:
Viewing: Pan-India Consolidated Orders (All 36 States & UTs)

Evox Two-Tier Channel Architecture & Dynamic ASM Routing B2B Core

Primary Orders (Company → PD): Direct factory replenishment supplied from Evox Central Depot with Custom SKU distributor pricing.
Secondary Orders (PD → SD): Retail stockists purchase from Primary Wholesalers with Custom stockist margin. If an SD's mapped PD depot has depleted inventory, the Area Sales Manager (ASM) holds order-wise authority to divert fulfillment to an alternate candidate PD depot with mandatory audit logging.

Organisation Hierarchy & Data Visibility

Each ASM reports to one RSM. An RSM sees their own records and their ASMs' records; an ASM sees only their own; System Admin sees everything. Change an ASM's manager here at any time.

Dropdown Lists

Edit the choices people pick from in forms: meeting purposes, industries, channels, quantity ranges, doctor specialities, product categories, states and cities. Existing records keep the value they were saved with.

Select a list

One option per line. To show different text than what is saved, write saved value | shown text.

Manage Records

Find and delete any entry: leads, distributors, stockists, doctors, visits, calls, orders, inquiries, plans and projections. Deleting cannot be undone. Related records (for example a dealer's orders) are not deleted with it.
